hero.label: Made for Lucent
hero.headline: I want to be the first GTM hire who helps Lucent win.
hero.subheadline: Lucent is solving a real pain point I saw firsthand in SaaS sales: teams flying blind on why users churn or get stuck. The idea of turning raw session data into actionable product and UX signals is genuinely exciting to me, and I want to be the person who takes that story to market from day one.

whyCompany.title: Lucent sits at the intersection of product intelligence and revenue
whyCompany.body: Most session replay tools show you what happened. Lucent is building something that tells SaaS teams what it means, which is a much harder and more valuable problem to solve. That distinction is a real wedge into product, engineering, and CS budgets simultaneously, and that kind of multi-stakeholder sale is where I thrive.

whyCompany.title: Founding GTM means the playbook is still blank
whyCompany.body: Lucent is at the stage where the first GTM hire shapes how the company goes to market for years. That is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a process. It is a role for someone who wants to build one, and that is exactly the kind of challenge I am looking for at 21.

whyCompany.title: I have already done this for a technical SaaS product
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach and LinkedIn sequences that helped the company acquire 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch, working HubSpot and building messaging for a product most prospects had never heard of. At NextAfter I learned how B2B buyers respond to testing-driven content and data storytelling. Lucent needs both of those skill sets on day one.

quote: I have spent the last year learning how to make technical SaaS products click for buyers who don't know they need them yet. Lucent is exactly the kind of company I want to do that for, and I want to do it before anyone else gets the chance.
